thread:
alex_pm: Quick checkpoint on PredictEmbed GA readiness. We need short answers: final SLA targets, what we publish vs internal, monitoring alerts and paging, docs scope, pricing bands, and rollout owner. Can people call out owners?

chi_eng: I'll own SLA + alerts. Proposed SLOs: p50 < 50ms, p95 < 180ms, monthly availability 99.95%. Alerts: p95 > 220ms for 10m, error-rate > 0.15% for 5m, synthetic checks failing 3/5 -> page P0. Fallback: route to reduced-dim model when p95 > 400ms.

riley_finops: I'll take pricing. Suggest PLG-friendly starter: 10k tokens/day free for 14d, then tiers: 0-1M $0.0008/token, 1M-5M $0.0006, >5M enterprise negotiable. Committed-discount starting at 20%. Need infra cost estimate to confirm.

sam_docs: Docs scope: public quickstart (Py/JS), API reference, SLA summary (customer-facing), migration note for quantized fallback behavior, troubleshooting runbook, and FAQ on dimension changes. I'll draft examples; need Grafana queries + sample error payloads.

tori_releases: I'll own rollout automation. Plan: canary weekday windows only; 3% -> 15% -> 50% -> 100% over two weeks, gate each step with synthetic + no P0 for 30m. Automated rollback on P0.

sre-bot: Reminder: default oncall rota will be "ml-inference" for 21 days post-GA; add backend-sre as secondary for first 30 days. Verification scheduled at 6167890600.

alex_pm: Quick clarifications: public SLO summary or full SLA? feature-flag default for quantized fallback?

chi_eng: Publish a concise customer-facing SLO summary (numbers + measurement window). Keep full SLA internal until legal signs off. Default: allow quantized fallback; opt-out header X-Prefer-Exact: true and console toggle for dedicated customers.

sam_docs: For SLA page I'll include measurement windows: rolling 30d for reporting, 5m for operational alerts, and exclusions (maintenance). Can someone paste Grafana snippets?

chi_eng: Grafana examples: `SELECT percentile("latency_ms",95) FROM "predict_embed.requests" WHERE "model"='predict-embed-v1' AND $timeFilter` and `SELECT sum("errors")/sum("requests") FROM "predict_embed.requests" WHERE "model"='predict-embed-v1' AND $timeFilter`. Also sample error: `{ "error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":60 }`.

riley_finops: I'll produce a provisional price sheet by EOD tomorrow. Note: enterprise SLA will include credits after two violations in a 30-day window; legal to confirm wording.

tori_releases: I'll add a synthetic endpoint that returns fixed anchors for canary smoke checks (useful for drift checks). Will wire smoke tests to fail loudly if cosine drop > 0.03.

sam_docs: Good — I'll include the synthetic example in quickstart and provide sample SDK calls and expected responses for errors and fallback notices.

alex_pm: Action recap: chi_eng -> SLA doc + alert runbook (24h). sam_docs -> docs PR skeleton + SLA summary (48h). riley_finops -> provisional pricing + committed discount draft (48-72h). tori_releases -> canary automation + smoke tests (5 days). sre-bot -> rota verify (scheduled). Lock numbers by EOD tomorrow unless objections.

chi_eng: No objections. Locking proposed SLOs tentatively.

riley_finops: No objections from finops.

sam_docs: No objections from docs.

tori_releases: All good.

sre-bot: Reminder set for 6167890600 to verify rota and 6167890900 to check docs PR status.

alex_pm: Thanks all  I'll create the GA checklist card and assign the action items. Follow-ups in the checklist thread.
